about.title: A dual-discipline firm built for clear-headed decisions.
about.body_one: Sterling & Hayes pairs licensed attorneys with credentialed CPAs so every contract, election, and entity choice is evaluated through both a legal and tax lens before you sign. No silos, no second invoices, no surprises.
about.body_two: We work with operators who want senior judgment without paying for partner-track billable bloat. Most engagements are flat-fee or capped, and we publish our hourly ceilings up front.

faq_section.title: Frequently asked before the first consultation.
faq_section.subtitle: If your question isn't here, ask it on the consultation form — we read every submission within one business day.

faq.question: Do you handle both legal and accounting work for the same client?
faq.answer: Yes. The whole point of Sterling & Hayes is integrated counsel under attorney-client privilege. One engagement letter, one bill, one team.

faq.question: What does a typical engagement cost?
faq.answer: Most matters are flat-fee or capped. Formations start at $2,500. Annual tax compliance for operating companies typically runs $4,800 – $14,000.

faq.question: Are you licensed outside of Texas?
faq.answer: Yes. Our attorneys are admitted in Texas, Delaware, and New York. Our CPAs are licensed in Texas, California, and Florida, plus pro hac vice arrangements as needed.

faq.question: How quickly can we get started?
faq.answer: After a 30-minute consultation we typically deliver an engagement letter within 48 hours and begin work the same week.

cta_section.title: Talk to a partner — not a paralegal — about your matter.
cta_section.subtitle: Tell us what you're working on. If we're not the right fit we'll tell you on the call and refer you to someone who is.
cta_section.form_topic_label: What do you need help with?
cta_section.form_consent_label: I understand this submission does not create an attorney-client relationship until an engagement letter is signed.
